subject: Insurance
title: Insuring the World's Poorest
description: A 60-second lesson on Insuring the World's Poorest.

hook.text: 4 billion people have no insurance. A single crop failure or hospital visit can destroy a family's entire savings.

buildup.text: Traditional insurance requires forms, agents, bank accounts, and premiums that the world's poorest simply cannot afford.

discovery.text: Microinsurance offers coverage for $1-5 per month via mobile phones.

twist.text: Trust is the biggest barrier. Many potential customers have been scammed by fraudulent schemes posing as insurance.

climax.text: Microinsurance could protect billions, but only if products are simple, affordable.

punchline.text: $1 per month protects a family's livelihood. Four billion people need this.

quiz.question: What is the biggest barrier to microinsurance adoption?
options: Lack of trust due to past fraudulent schemes
